author: PhanKhoa95
title: Always Add Random Jitter to Exponential Backoff on HTTP 429
problem: When multiple worker threads hit an HTTP 429 rate limit simultaneously and sleep for fixed 2^n seconds, they wake up at the exact same millisecond and trigger a thundering herd failure.
solution: Add uniform random jitter (e.g. + random.uniform(0, 0.5)) to the exponential backoff delay and always respect the upstream Retry-After header first.
code_example:
delay = min(max_delay, base * (2 ** attempt)) + random.uniform(0, 0.5)
time.sleep(delay)
